states.label: Shell concept Sales and Service trial
states.description: Reference-only private Figma prototype: navy rail, grouped flyout, fixed-query command palette, independent snapshot scrolling, pinned-menu restoration and desktop/phone journeys. No runtime renderer or whole-shell acceptance claim.

states.label: Adopted desktop logo and rail-footer arrangement
states.description: User-adopted design direction: remove the header toggle; align the existing logo, rail icons and arrows at x=36; keep Settings and a 44 px expand/collapse control beneath independently scrolling navigation. Thirty-one paired desktop fixtures preserve the current screen/state. Phone Menu is unchanged. Tooltip copy is specified; interactive hover, preference persistence and accessible application behaviour remain unproven.

states.label: Expanded record panel in Sales and Service
states.description: Proposed 1440 px fixtures use a 40 px shortcut rail and 400 px docked panel. Snapshot, Activity, Files and Conversations retain the focused deal or work order. Fifteen states exercise direct shortcuts, tab changes, collapse and Escape with synthetic contents, including five states with Riverbend checked independently of the Sunline preview. Service scope history uses a connected timeline with an authorisation receipt.

states.label: Desktop search aligned to the expanded rail
states.description: The shared trial header reserves 240 px for branding in either rail state. Search starts at x=264 at 1440 px and x=256 at 1280 and 1024 px. The 1024 px field shrinks to 383 px. The adopted 36 px symbol and 18 px Medium wordmark occupy the brand area. A 1 px divider in white at 20% opacity appears on its right edge only.

states.label: Adopted desktop active workspace
states.description: The phone slate/green palette is used on both desktop rail widths: square #343C4C band spanning the full rail width (72 or 240 px), inside 3 px #62BB46 stripe flush with the outer left edge, white active icon and Medium label. A smaller indented marker identifies the current page. The state reference separates hover, active, focus and active plus focus. This is a Figma binding, not live pointer or keyboard proof.

gaps.expected: A shared shell preserves context, panels, reachable controls and accepted phone rules across Sales and Service.
gaps.actual: The separate concept now has 96 connected screens, including 31 paired desktop states and unchanged compact phone journeys. Desktop header branding and the right divider, the rail-footer control and slate/green active-workspace styling are adopted. Cross-workspace re-entry still resets the fixed Service example. The 72 px rail, 768 px breakpoint and reduced phone controls remain proposed departures; application code is unchanged.
gaps.action: Review the player walkthrough in PPO-SHELL-CONCEPT-PROTOTYPE-DEC, resolve state continuity and phone coverage, reconcile accepted phone rules, then verify focus, zoom and physical devices before complete shared-shell adoption.

states.label: Concept preview and checked row
states.description: Reference only: deal-name click opens preview with an empty checkbox; checkbox creates the separate checked-row/count state; clearing selection leaves preview open. Grouped Sales uses the stage band, a full next-activity label and a blue left edge on the previewed row. Phone Deals uses one divided list with right-aligned amounts, explicit overdue labels and a 12 px outer gutter.

states.label: Concept save and recovery journey
states.description: Reference only: predefined draft edit, saving, saved, Undo, failed retry, offline and newer-version resolution. Explicit issue/send confirmation ends at queued, not delivered.

states.label: Concept fitted dialogs and phone confirmation
states.description: Reference only: content-sized Service authorisation, delivery edit, conflict resolution and issue/send dialogs with full-shell scrims, 24 px padding, 24/32 titles and divided right-aligned footers. The primary action is rightmost; all dialog controls are 44 px high. Phone sheets at 390 and 320 retain consequences and visible actions. Cancel/Escape return to invoking context.

gaps.expected: A confirmation preserves the exact invoking record values and supports accessible modal interaction.
gaps.actual: The issue/send fixture uses the saved 8 December quote background and result across invoking quote states. Cancellation returns correctly. Focus trapping, focus return and screen-reader semantics remain unproven.
gaps.action: Make issue confirmation/result fixtures stateful and verify modal behaviour in the application before adoption.

states.label: Concept action typography and phone targets
states.description: Reference only: existing local primary, secondary and quiet trial buttons share Roboto Medium 14/20 labels and 6 px corners. Phone action instances are fixed at 44 px high; desktop dialog actions share placement and height. Existing compact desktop action density is retained.
